name: Minecraft: Arclight
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Arclight, a Minecraft Java server that runs Bukkit and Spigot plugins alongside Forge, NeoForge or Fabric mods. Any Minecraft version and loader Arclight has, checked against its checksums.
startup: mkdir -p plugins/bStats; b=plugins/bStats/config.yml; touch $b; if ! grep -q "^serverUuid:" $b; then read -r u < /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid; echo "serverUuid: \"$u\"" >> $b; fi; grep -q "^logFailedRequests:" $b || echo "logFailedRequests: false" >> $b; if grep -q "^enabled:" $b; then sed -i "s/^enabled:.*/enabled: {{BSTATS}}/" $b; else echo "enabled: {{BSTATS}}" >> $b; fi; read -r need most 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" -v most="$most" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } if (most != "" && have + 0 > most + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version runs on Java %s at most, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", most, have, most; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Arclight. Downloads the Arclight build for the chosen
# Minecraft version, loader and channel and checks it against its SHA-1.
# Worlds, mods, plugins and settings are never touched, and the jar is only
# replaced once the new one has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Installers work in a folder of the server's own (the install container's
# /tmp is small), removed however the script ends.
trap 'rm -rf .raptor-installer' EXIT

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# True when version $1 is $2 or older.
older_or_same() { [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$1" "$2" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = "$1" ]; }
# Downloads $1 to $2 and checks it against $3, its published checksum
# (sha256:…, sha1:… or md5:…); a jar with none must at least be a whole
# zip. Only then is it put in place.
fetch() {
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$2.new" "$1" || { rm -f "$2.new"; fail "The download from $1 failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ -n "${3:-}" ]; then
        if [ "$("${3%%:*}sum" "$2.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "${3#*:}" ]; then
            rm -f "$2.new"
            fail "The download didn't match its published checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        fi
    elif [[ $2 == *.jar ]] && ! unzip -tq "$2.new" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        rm -f "$2.new"
        fail "The download isn't a whole jar file. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mv -f "$2.new" "$2"
}
# True when file $1 has the checksum $2 (as fetch takes it).
matches() { [ -f "$1" ] && [ "$("${2%%:*}sum" "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "${2#*:}" ]; }
# The Java version Minecraft $1 needs, from Mojang's version list (8 for
# versions older than the list says).
java_for() {
    local url
    url=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r --arg v "$1" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url') || true
    if [ -n "$url" ]; then get "$url" | jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' || echo 8; else echo 8; fi
}
# Writes the Java versions the server runs on to .raptor-java, which the
# startup command checks: the oldest, and for $2 the newest, if any.
write_java() {
    echo "$1${2:+ $2}" > .raptor-java
}
# The newest Java that Forge, and the servers built on Forge or on its
# launcher, run on for Minecraft $1: 8 before 1.13 (LaunchWrapper), 11
# before 1.17 (the old ModLauncher fails on Java 16's locked-down
# internals). Nothing for newer versions.
java_most() {
    [[ $1 == 1.* ]] || return 0
    if older_or_same "$1" 1.12.2; then echo 8
    elif older_or_same "$1" 1.16.5; then echo 11; fi
}
# How to say which Java it runs on.
java_text() {
    if [ -z "${2:-}" ]; then echo "Java $1 or newer"
    elif [ "$1" = "$2" ]; then echo "Java $1 only"
    else echo "Java $1 to $2"; fi
}

api=https://files.hypoglycemia.icu/v1/files/arclight
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
loader="${ARCLIGHT_LOADER:-forge}"
channel="${ARCLIGHT_CHANNEL:-auto}"
unreachable="Arclight's downloads can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the server jar from $DOWNLOAD_URL"
    fetch "$DOWNLOAD_URL" "$jar"
    rm -f .raptor-java
    echo "Installed the server jar from $DOWNLOAD_URL."
    exit 0
fi

versions=$(get "$api/minecraft" | jq -r '.files[].name' | sort -rV) || fail "$unreachable"
mc="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
case "$mc" in
latest | auto) mc=$(head -n 1 <<<"$versions") ;;
*) grep -qxF -- "$mc" <<<"$versions" ||
    fail "Arclight has no Minecraft $mc. Set Minecraft version to latest, or to one of $(paste -sd, <<<"$versions" | sed 's/,/, /g')." ;;
esac

loaders=$(get "$api/minecraft/$mc/loaders" | jq -r '.files[].name') || fail "$unreachable"
grep -qxF -- "$loader" <<<"$loaders" ||
    fail "Arclight for Minecraft $mc has no $loader version. Set Loader to one it has: $(paste -sd, <<<"$loaders" | sed 's/,/, /g')."

channels=$(get "$api/minecraft/$mc/loaders/$loader" | jq -r '.files[].name') || fail "$unreachable"
case "$channel" in
stable) dirs=versions-stable ;;
beta) dirs=versions-snapshot ;;
*) dirs="versions-stable versions-snapshot" ;;
esac
build=""
for d in $dirs; do
    grep -qxF "$d" <<<"$channels" || continue
    build=$(get "$api/minecraft/$mc/loaders/$loader/$d" | jq -c '[.files[] | select(.type == "object")] | sort_by(."last-modified") | last // empty') || fail "$unreachable"
    [ -n "$build" ] && break
done
[ -n "$build" ] || fail "Arclight for Minecraft $mc on $loader has no $channel build. Set Release channel to auto, or choose another version or loader."
[ "$d" = versions-snapshot ] && [ "$channel" = auto ] && echo "Arclight for Minecraft $mc on $loader has no stable build yet, so this is a beta."

name=$(jq -r .name <<<"$build")
# Builds are stored by their SHA-1, which checks the download.
sha1=$(jq -r '.permlink | sub(".*/"; "")' <<<"$build")
if matches "$jar" "sha1:$sha1"; then
    echo "Arclight $name for Minecraft $mc on $loader is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Arclight $name for Minecraft $mc on $loader"
    fetch "https://files.hypoglycemia.icu/v1/objects/$sha1" "$jar" "sha1:$sha1"
fi
need=$(java_for "$mc")
most=$(java_most "$mc")
write_java "$need" "$most"
echo "Installed Arclight $name for Minecraft $mc on $loader. It downloads the rest of what it needs the first time it starts, and runs on $(java_text "$need" "$most")."

variables.name: Minecraft version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.1, or latest for the newest one Arclight supports. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Loader
variables.description: Which mods it runs: forge, neoforge, or fabric, if Arclight has that loader for the version.

variables.name: Release channel
variables.description: stable, beta, or auto for the newest stable build or a beta when there's none.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to download the server jar from instead of Arclight, which only staff can set.

variables.name: Usage statistics
variables.description: Send anonymous statistics about the server and its plugins to bStats.org, where plugin authors see them (true or false).
